remarks: Seize a rare opportunity to own a bespoke estate in New Canaan's most coveted Ultra-Prime West Road location. Set on 6.5 private acres, this exceptional new construction by the renowned Woodcrest Homes is a triumph of transitional design, offering clean lines and unrivaled craftsmanship. The residence boasts seven magnificent ensuite bedrooms and a floor plan optimized for a sophisticated modern lifestyle, featuring a chef's kitchen that flows into a family room with elegant coffered ceiling, fireplace and built-ins. The primary sanctuary is a work of art, featuring tray ceiling and a spa-like bath with radiant heat floors-a luxury mirrored in the oversized mudroom. From the paneled library to the four roaring fireplaces and finished third and lower levels, every inch reflects the custom millwork and "stellar reputation" Woodcrest is known for. Outside, the massive acreage serves as a blank canvas with ample room for a pool, pool house, and sports court. With professional designer finishes selected by Tara Coniglio, this isn't just a house-it is a legacy estate tailored to your exact vision. NEW CONSTRUCTION just completed and ready for IMMEDIATE OCCUPANCY.
